title: Baggage Allowance
content: Demo policy: baggage allowance depends on cabin and fare family. Passengers should verify the allowance shown on their ticket before travel.

title: Disrupted Flights
content: Demo policy: when a flight is significantly delayed or cancelled, the assistant may suggest alternative itineraries and escalation to an airline agent. Final rebooking must be confirmed by a human.

title: Transit at Doha
content: Demo guidance: passengers transiting through Doha should verify connection time, gate information, and entry requirements when leaving the transit area.

title: Special Assistance
content: Demo guidance: accessibility, medical, and special-meal requests should be confirmed with the airline before departure.
